newsitem.title: USA: French Fragrances readies first junk bond offering.
newsitem.headline: French Fragrances readies first junk bond offering.

text.p: French Fragrances Inc plans to debut in the junk bond market in the next several weeks with an offering of $100 million in 10-year senior unsecured notes, market sources said.
Proceeds will be used to refinance debt and for general corporate purposes, they added.
The 144a private placement offering will be underwritten by Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Toronto Dominion Securities.
French Frangrances is a Miami, Florida-based manufacturer and distributor of fragrances. Calls to the company were not immediately returned.
